caption: The drawing depicts a horse bridle and reins, along with a separate whip or lash. The bridle is primarily composed of brown leather straps with a metal bit and metal cheekpieces, which have a slightly curved shape and several attachment points for the reins and headstall. The metal components are rendered in a gray tone, indicating their metallic nature. The reins are attached to the bit and are made of a lighter-colored, cord-like material that appears grayish or beige. The headstall and browband of the bridle are also crafted from brown leather, with visible stitching and buckles. To the left of the bridle and reins, there is a long, single whip or lash, which is similarly made of a cord or rope material, and features a split leather tip at the end. The objects are set against an off-white background and are displayed with careful attention to the arrangement and detail of each part, with all objects lying flat and coiled or draped naturally.
title: Bridle with Braided Rawhide Reins
